business_summary: Wisdom Education International Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding company, operates schools in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It offers private education for primary, middle, and high schools. The company also engages in the sale of daily necessities and educational materials for school related businesses. In addition, it is involved in educational services comprising extracurricular activities, and study tour. Further, the company engages in information technology outsourcing and educational consultancy services, as well as invests in education activities. The company was formerly known as Wisdom Education Group Company Limited. Wisdom Education International Holdings Company Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Wisdom Education International Holdings Company Limited는 중화인민공화국과 홍콩에서 학교를 운영하고 있습니다. 초, 중, 고등학교에 사교육을 제공하고 있습니다. 또한, 학교 관련 사업체를 위한 생필품 및 교육자료 판매도 하고 있습니다. 또한 과외 활동, 견학 등의 교육 서비스에도 참여하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 정보 기술 아웃소싱 및 교육 컨설팅 서비스에 종사하고 교육 활동에 투자합니다. 이 회사는 이전에는 Wisdom Education Group Company Limited로 알려졌습니다. Wisdom Education International Holdings Company Limited는 2010년에 설립되었으며 중국 동관에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
